method: Real production Chromium viewport screenshots and native Playwright browser videos. Native wheel input drives forward/reverse browsing; real links provide previous-project and Work navigation. H.264 transcodes retain browser timing. The SOL and Bunzo loops visibly play for at least eight seconds each without seeking. Full-page stills use a separate software compositor to avoid cloud SwiftShader tall-image repetition. Mobile is Chromium touch/viewport emulation, not physical-device testing.
